decisions.quote:
The code did compile fine when using Stata
17 and produced all tables and graphs that were reported in the paper’s main body and
appendices.
decisions.reason: Running the original replication package in Stata 17 reproduced all tables and figures reported in the paper, satisfying the codebook criterion for 'computationally reproducible'. The two coding errors identified by the author were mistakes in the original script's order-dummy construction and curvature formula that already produced the published numbers, and correcting them was evaluated as a robustness re-analysis.
